Valencia Street Circuit hosted five races between 2000 and 2025, with these winners:

- 2008: Felipe Massa
- 2009: Rubens Barrichello
- 2010: Sebastian Vettel
- 2011: Sebastian Vettel
- 2012: Fernando Alonso

Sebastian Vettel won two of them (2010 and 2011), more than any other driver.

ANSWER: Sebastian Vettel
